## Packages

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(grid)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)
library(betareg)
library(maps)
library(sf)

```

## Import CHNA Data

```{r, chna-data}

data1 <- read_csv("Data/countyclean.csv")

```
## Priorities

```{r, health-priorities}

priority_long1 <- data1 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Priority"),
    names_to = "Priority",
    values_to = "Topic"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(County),
    !is.na(Topic),
    Topic != ""
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Priority = factor(
      Priority,
      levels = paste("Priority", 1:5)
    )
  )

```

## Unique Counties

```{r, unique-counties}

# Count counties identifying each topic within each priority
county_priority1 <- priority_long1 %>%
  distinct(County, Priority, Topic) %>%
  count(Priority, Topic, name = "Counties")

```


## IPLAN Priority Plot


```{r, iplan-priority-plot}

make_iplan_priority_plot <- function(priority_number) {

  county_data <- county_priority1 %>%
    filter(Priority == paste("Priority", priority_number)) %>%
    arrange(Counties)

  ggplot(
    county_data,
    aes(
      x = Counties,
      y = reorder(Topic, Counties),
      fill = Topic
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7) +

    geom_text(
      aes(label = Counties),
      hjust = -0.2,
      size = 2.5
    ) +

    scale_fill_manual(
      values = topic_colors,
      na.value = "gray70"
    ) +

    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, NA),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))
    ) +

    labs(
      title = paste("Priority", priority_number),
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +

    theme_minimal() +

    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 10,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
    )
}




```

## Final IPLAN Plot

```{r}

c1 <- make_iplan_priority_plot(1)
c2 <- make_iplan_priority_plot(2)
c3 <- make_iplan_priority_plot(3)
c4 <- make_iplan_priority_plot(4)
c5 <- make_iplan_priority_plot(5)

final_iplan_plot <- (c1 | c2) /
                     (c3 | c4) /
                     (c5 | plot_spacer()) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Distribution of CHNA Health Priorities Across Illinois Counties",
    caption = "Number of Counties Identifying Each Health Topic",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 15,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0
      ),
      plot.caption = element_text(
        size = 10,
        hjust = 0.5,
        margin = margin(t = 10)
      )
    )
  )

final_iplan_plot


```

## Save

```{r, save}

ggsave(
  filename = "graph/idpha_iplan.png",
  plot = final_iplan_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)

```
